verdict.rationale: mise defines and runs project tasks on demand (`mise run`), re-runs them on file changes (`mise watch`), and runs postinstall hooks. None of these is a time-based recurring schedule, and nothing in the evidence documents cron-like scheduling of tasks or workflows. Recurring scheduling is a fair axis for a task runner, so the absence of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
